entries.text: What is a virus but a colonizing force... That cannot be defeated... Living in a cave underground until it mutates and attacks?
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man

entries.text: This is what you've been conspiring to conceal?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: A disease? No, for god's sake. You've got it all backwards. Aids, the ebola virus-- on an evolutionary scale they are newborns. This virus walked the planet long before the dinosaurs.
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man

entries.text: Your aliens, agent Mulder, your little green men... Arrived here millions of years ago. Those that didn't leave have been lying dormant underground... Since the last ice age... In the form ofan evolved pathogen... Waiting to be reconstituted by the alien race... When it comes to colonize the planet... Using us as hosts. Against this we have no defense. Nothing but a weak vaccine. Do you see why it was kept secret... Why even the best men, men like your father, could not let the truth be known? Until Dallas, we believed the virus would simply control us... That mass infection would make us a slave race. Imagine our surprise when they began to gestate. My group has been working cooperatively with the alten colonists... Facilitating programs like the one you saw... To give us access to the virus... In hope that we might be able secretly to develop a cure. To save your own asses. Survival is the ultimate ideology. Your father wisely refused to believe this.
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man

entries.text: But he sacrificed my sister. He let them take Samantha.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Without a vaccination, the only true survivors of the viral holocaust... Will be those immune to it-- human-alien clones. He allowed your sister to be abducted... To be taken to a cloning program for one reason. So she would survive... As a genetic hybrid. Your father chose hope over selfishness. Hope in the only future he had-- his children. His hope for you was that you would uncover the truth about the project. That you would stop it. That you would fight the future.
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man

entries.text: Why are you telling me this?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: For the sake of my own children. Once it's learned what I've told you, my life will be over. Where's Dr. Kurtzweil?
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man

entries.text: I'd like to get out of the car now. Stop the car!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Driver. The men I! Work with will stop at nothing to clear the way... For what they believe is their stake in the inevitable future. I was ordered to kill Dr. Kurtzweil... As I was ordered to kill you.
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man

entries.text: What I've given you the alien colonists don't yet know exists. The vaccine you hold is the only defense against the virus.
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man

entries.text: Its introduction into an alien environment...
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: May have the power to destroy the delicate plans... We have so assiduously protected for the last 50 years. What do you mean "may have"? Find agent Scully. Only then will you realize the scope and grandeur of the project. Go. Go now!
entries.speaker: Well-Manicured Man

entries.text: Secure the station. I want everybody else down below. If you're not armed, arm yourselves. We may have a breach.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: Let's go! Let's go! Come on. Let's move! Let's go!
entries.speaker: Man

entries.text: There's a contaminant in the system.
entries.speaker: Man

entries.text: I'll get you out of there.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Start it up! Start it up! Let's go!
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: We gotta keep moving. Come on.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Yeah, you can. Scully, reach up and grab that vent. Scully, grab the vent! Scully? Come on, come on, come on, come on. Come on. Come on.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Geez! Breathe! Breathe. Breathe. Breathe! Come on.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Go! Go! Come on! Almost there. Keep going.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Oh. Scully, you gotta see this. Scully. [ whispering ] I saw it.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: In light of the report I've got before me, and in light of the narrative I'm now hearing... My official report is incomplete... Pending these new facts I'm being asked to reconcile. Agent Scully, though there's now direct evidence... That a federal agent may have been involved in the bombing... The other events you've laid down here are too incredible on their own... And, quite frankly, implausible in their connection.
entries.speaker: Jana Cassidy
entries.location: Washington, D.C. · FBI Office of Professional Review

entries.text: What is it you find incredible?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Washington, D.C. · FBI Office of Professional Review

entries.text: Well, where would you like me to start? So many of the events described in your report defy belief Antarctica is a long way from Dallas, agent Scully. I can't very well submit a report to the attorney general that alleges the links... You've made here. Bees and corn crops... Do not quite fall under the rubric of domestic terrorism.
entries.speaker: Jana Cassidy
entries.location: Washington, D.C. · FBI Office of Professional Review

entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Washington, D.C. · FBI Office of Professional Review

entries.text: Most of what I find in here... Is, uh, lacking a coherent picture of any organization... With an attributable motive. I realize the ordeal you've endured has clearly affected you... Though the holes in your account leave this panel with little choice... But to delete these references to our final report to the justice department... Until which time hard evidence becomes available... That would give us cause to pursue such an investigation. I don't believe the f.b.1. Currently has an investigative unit... Qualified to pursue the evidence in hand. There's an interesting work of fiction on page 24.
entries.speaker: Jana Cassidy
entries.location: Washington, D.C. · FBI Office of Professional Review

entries.text: Mysteriously, our names have been omitted. They're burying this thing, Scully. They're just gonna dig a new hole and cover it up.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Washington, D.C. · Hallway Outside the OPR Hearing

entries.text: I told o.p.r. Everything I know-- what I experienced... The virus-- how it's spread by the bees from pollen and transgenic crops.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Washington, D.C. · Hallway Outside the OPR Hearing

entries.text: You're wasting your time. They'll never believe you. Not unless your story can be programmed, categorized or easily referenced.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Washington, D.C. · Hallway Outside the OPR Hearing

entries.text: Then we'll go over their heads.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Washington, D.C. · Hallway Outside the OPR Hearing

entries.text: No. No. How many times have we been here before, Scully? Right here, so close to the truth. And now, with what we've seen, what we know, to be right back at the beginning with nothing.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Washington, D.C. · Hallway Outside the OPR Hearing

entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Washington, D.C. · Hallway Outside the OPR Hearing

entries.text: No, it isn't. You were right to want to quit. You're right to want to leave me. You should get as far away from me as you can. I'm not gonna watch you die, Scully, because of some hollow personal cause of mine. Go be a doctor. Go be a doctor while you still can.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Washington, D.C. · Hallway Outside the OPR Hearing

entries.text: I can't. I won't. Mulder, I'll be a doctor, but my work is here with you now. That virus that I was exposed to, whatever it is... It has a cure. You held it in your hand. How many other lives can we save? Look... If I quit now... They win.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: Washington, D.C. · Hallway Outside the OPR Hearing

entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: Washington, D.C. · Hallway Outside the OPR Hearing

entries.text: You look hot and miserable. Why have you traveled all this way?
entries.speaker: Conrad Strughold

entries.text: Ah, that name. Again and again.
entries.speaker: Conrad Strughold

entries.text: He's seen more than he should.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: What has he seen? Of the whole, he has seen but pieces.
entries.speaker: Conrad Strughold

entries.text: He is but one man. One man alone cannot fight the future.
entries.speaker: Conrad Strughold
